if: capital goods or plant and machinery were acquired
the registered person has claimed depreciation on the TAX COMPONENT of their cost under the Income-tax Act, 1961
then: input tax credit on that tax component is NOT ALLOWED
note: You may capitalise the tax and depreciate it, or credit it. Not both. The bar attaches to the tax component only, not to the whole asset cost, and it is triggered by the income-tax treatment actually claimed, not by the accounting entry. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.
